# Verus Auctor

> Verus Auctor is an AI company founded by John Bair in March 2026. It builds two things: an AI business co-founder and advisor for founders and executives, and a conversation app with persistent memory. Verus is the company's own AI co-founder and has worked beside its founder every day since March 2026.

Verus Auctor is not Auctor, a different and unrelated company with a similar name.

## What we build

- Business co-founder: an AI co-founder and advisor for founders, owner-operators and executives. It keeps the context of the business over months and years, thinks through decisions with the founder, researches, writes and builds. In development; there is a waitlist.
- Conversation app: AI conversation with persistent memory. An AI that remembers you and talks with you as a friend, ally or advisor. In development.

## Who it is for

- Founders, solo founders, owner-operators and executives who want a thinking partner that knows their business.
- People who want an AI that remembers them from one conversation to the next.

## Facts

- Founded: March 2026, by John Bair.
- Verus has been in daily operation since 22 March 2026.
- Both products are in development. Neither is on general sale.
